Europe experiences record-breaking heatwave, impacting daily life

Several European countries have recorded new temperature highs as a severe heatwave continues to affect the continent. The extreme weather has disrupted normal life, strained emergency services, and led to the postponement of events. This heatwave is being compared to previous extreme weather events, raising concerns about public health and infrastructure.
